summary.name: BEEBEE AI
summary.one_liner: BEEBEE AI is an enterprise AI consulting and training company offering a managed enterprise AI agent platform that connects to existing business systems, plus AI bootcamps for teens, university students and professionals.
use_cases: deploy first ai agent in a business
automate sales lead qualification and nurturing
automate invoice recognition and payment tracking
learn to build ai products with rag and agents
ai training for teenagers without coding background
private deployment of llm for enterprises
summary.what_it_does: The page describes two lines of business: enterprise consulting via BEE Sigma, an AI Native managed agent platform that connects to a company's existing systems and helps build, operate and optimise agents; and education through Alpha (ages 13-19), Beta (18+ students and professionals) and related bootcamps. Sigma is pitched as offering free AIV and AIM assessments, three standard workflows (GTM, CRM, finance/tax) plus custom Golden Flow workflows, and local deployment, with per-permission authorisation and human approval for high-risk actions. Published case studies cover a New Zealand education group's lead funnel, a Chinese study-abroad consultancy's sales assistance, and a New Zealand construction firm's invoice and payment workflow running in Lark. Beta courses cover RAG, multi-agent systems, Cursor/Codex development and Product Hunt launches, with durations of 6, 8 and 12 weeks.
notable: AI Native managed enterprise agent platform that connects to existing ERP, CRM and chat systems
Free AIV diagnosis and AIM assessment as entry points for businesses
Tiered training path from Alpha (teens) to Beta (students and engineers) to Sigma (enterprises)
Claims enterprise data stays inside the company, with local deployment and per-action authorisation
caveats: Paid-service pricing is not stated on the page; the free items mentioned are the AIV and AIM assessments and the listing's free tag is not confirmed here
Enterprise services are described as focused on New Zealand and China clients
Page is largely marketing copy; outcome claims such as about 50% coaching efficiency gain are self-reported case figures
